choices: Applies that commit’s changes as a new commit on the current branch
Replaces git merge for all branches
items.explain: Cherry-pick replays one commit’s patch onto HEAD, creating a new commit with a new SHA.

items.prompt: After fixing cherry-pick conflicts you usually…
choices: git add the resolved files, then git cherry-pick --continue
items.explain: Stage resolutions, then continue; use --abort to cancel the in-progress pick.

items.prompt: Cherry-pick moves the original commit off the source branch.
items.explain: The source commit stays; cherry-pick adds a new commit on the target branch.

items.prompt: Cherry-pick is a good fit when…
choices: You need one fix from another branch, not a full merge
You want to ignore all history forever
You never know the commit hash
items.explain: Selective apply: one bugfix or backport without merging the entire branch.
